scripts.name: a parameter that was set is put back and set again
a drag is one step that goes back to before it
a pause of more than a second makes a step of its own
a pause of exactly a second does not
another thing is a step of its own, and so is going back to the first
a change after an undo ends what could be redone
an intent that is refused changes nothing in the history

scripts.name: an effect that was moved is put back, and the structure is said to have changed
the same knob of another node is a step of its own, though no time has gone by
a gain is a step for each node and each kind of gain, and the same one again is the same step
a setting of a modulator is a step for each modulator and each setting, and the same one again is the same step
the depth of a cable is a step for each cable, and the same one again is the same step
